# Repository state dependence causing exceptions

These methods assume the repository path points to a valid Git working tree. If used on incorrect paths or malformed repositories, exceptions may propagate unexpectedly aside from explicit subprocess errors.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/git.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.git.GitCollector`
